india-macro.title: WPI inflation quickens to 11.39% in September from 9.9% in August
india-macro.summary: Wholesale prices in India rose significantly to 11.39% in September, driven by rising fuel and food costs. Retail inflation also increased to 5.54%, attributed largely to higher vegetable prices. Concerns remain over food inflation maintaining elevated levels due to factors like uneven monsoon rainfall and El Nino risks. Increased global commodity prices are further affecting food production costs and transportation expenses.

india-macro.summary: The Finance Ministry has unveiled an important amendment to the India-Mauritius Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement.
